amihud.definition: 1e6 * abs(4-hour log return) / positive Binance spot quote turnover in USDT

future_amihud.definition: arithmetic mean of six 4-hour Amihud observations t+1:t+6

future_corwin_schultz_spread_24h.definition: mean of five consecutive 4-hour Corwin-Schultz high-low estimates based on adjacent bars wholly within t+1:t+6
future_corwin_schultz_spread_24h.interpretation_limit: range-based spread proxy can also reflect volatility; not an observed bid-ask quote

future_kyle_abs_lambda_24h.construction_evidence: verified deterministic Phase-7 builder source and 6,195 cached archive hashes; Phase-7 offline panel rebuild and full source audit passed; not independently reconstructed from 5-minute bars in this reanalysis
future_kyle_abs_lambda_24h.definition: absolute intercept-adjusted OLS slope of 288 following 5-minute spot log returns on signed spot USDT quote flow (2*taker-buy quote volume - total quote volume)
future_kyle_abs_lambda_24h.unit: return per USDT signed quote flow

post_2024_timestamp_audit: valid under frozen per-date OI offset mapping; unresolved concern is piecewise source timestamp harmonization, retained as measurement limitation
